hero.eyebrow: For restaurants, cafés and beach bars
hero.title: Guests order from the table.
hero.lead: The QR code on the table opens your menu on the guest's phone. The order lands on your kitchen screen at once, and guests pay at the end as always: cash or card.

commission.title: No commission
commission.body: One flat monthly price. No cut of your orders, however many there are.

pay.title: Payment stays the same
pay.body: Guests pay at the end, in cash or by card on your own terminal. The waiter closes the bill with one tap.

devices.title: No new hardware
devices.body: A tablet, phone or computer for the orders, and the codes printed on your tables. That's all.

step1.title: Scan the code
step1.body: Every table has its own code. The phone camera opens your menu with photos, in Albanian or English.
step1.alt: The restaurant's menu on a phone, with photos and prices

step2.title: Choose and order
step2.body: Descriptions, allergens and choices like portion or side. The price always follows your menu.
step2.alt: A dish with its choices, ready to add to the basket

step3.title: Follow the order, pay at the end
step3.body: Guests see when the kitchen gets and prepares their order, and what the table's bill is so far.
step3.alt: The order being prepared and the table's bill on a phone

board.title: Your whole service on one screen
board.lead: The dashboard opens on any tablet or computer. Orders and waiter calls arrive live with a chime: no printer, no paper slips.
board.alt: The orders dashboard: new, preparing and served orders, and a table calling the waiter

live.title: Live orders, with a chime
live.body: Every new order appears on screen with a chime. One tap moves it to preparing, another to served.

call.title: Call the waiter
call.body: Guests call from their phone. The table stays at the top of the screen until someone taps “On my way”.

menu.title: Your menu, in seconds
menu.body: Change prices, photos and dishes yourself. Ran out of something? Mark it sold out and guests see it at once.

bill.title: Every table's bill
bill.body: See what each table has ordered and close the bill when the guests pay.

languages.title: Albanian and English
languages.body: The menu and the screens in both languages, for locals and tourists alike.

brand.title: Your venue, your look
brand.body: Your colour, logo and photo on the menu. Print your tables' QR cards yourself from the dashboard.

pilot.title: We're looking for our first restaurants
pilot.body: We're starting with a few venues, so Urdho fits the way you actually work. We help you put your menu in and get your staff going.
pilot.priceNote: After the pilot, one flat monthly price, no commission on orders.
pilot.include1: Your menu with photos, in Albanian and English
pilot.include2: A QR code for every table
pilot.include3: The dashboard for kitchen, bar and waiters

app.q: Do guests need to download an app?
app.a: No. The menu opens in the phone's browser as soon as they scan the code.

pay.a: As they do today: at the end, in cash or by card on your terminal. The waiter marks the bill paid on the dashboard.

need.q: What do I need to start?
need.a: Internet, a tablet, phone or computer for the dashboard, and the QR codes printed on your tables.

commission.q: Do you take a cut of orders?
commission.a: No. You pay one flat monthly price, however many orders you get.

soldOut.q: What if a dish runs out during service?
soldOut.a: Mark it sold out with one tap. Guests see it straight away and can't order it.

menu.a: You do, from the dashboard, with photos, prices and choices. During the pilot, we help.

final.title: Let's try it at your place.
final.body: Write to us and we'll show you how it would work in your venue.

contact.message: Hello! I'd like to know more about Urdho for my venue.
contact.subject: Urdho for my venue
